phase_title: Dashboard Hero — Identity Tints + Bento + Count-up
commit_message: phase 5 (aurora): per-page identity tints + bento + count-up + greet
approach: Preservation-first augmentation: did NOT replace #page-dashboard markup. Instead added (a) tint tokens that activate via [data-active-tint] on <html>, (b) bento + dock + stat-tile utility classes for future content surfaces, and (c) JS observers that automatically opt-in existing .cath-stat-value elements into count-up animation without changing their HTML.
tokens_added: --tint-dashboard / callcenter / fieldsales / accountmgr / social / lab / psych / eq / negotiation / customercare / programming / accounting / phonerepair / hrmastery / myprogress (15 identity tints)
behaviors_added: navigateTo wrapped — auto-sets [data-active-tint] on every page change
MutationObserver on .page.active class — fallback for any other navigation path
Time-of-day greeting (4-band: morning, afternoon, evening, night) refreshes every 30 min
IntersectionObserver-driven count-up triggers on 35% visibility, respects prefers-reduced-motion
Cath-stat-value elements auto-opted-in to count-up without HTML changes
Re-observation on upg:lazy-mount and upg:state-update events
next_phase: 6 — Motion & Interaction (easing tokens, springs, cursor glow, page transitions)
